summary: November 11, 2026 briefing compared with November 9. New confirmed Walmart drawing window: November 12, 5–6 p.m. EST / 2–3 p.m. PST for four Pokémon offers; UPC listing explicitly says receive one at random. This is an event/assortment clarification, not a proven newly introduced policy. No substantive new purchase-limit or checkout-rule change established for November 4–11. Target Delta Reign listings remain out of stock; Pokémon Center estimates remain mid-November. Current US Greninja article and Sam's terms could not be verified; source and local-stock limitations are recorded below.

retailers.coverage: Four Delta Reign pages, preorder help and terms rechecked against November 9; same prices, IDs, out-of-stock/final-sale status and past street date. Other five 30th Celebration pages were not refreshed this edition and are omitted from current listing coverage. Numeric caps, future opening hours, signed-in checkout and local stock unverified. This is not an exhaustive TCG catalog.

confirmed.title: Drawing and aggregated quantity baseline
confirmed.details: Account required; free entry once per drawing. Address, payment and quantity lock at entry, which cannot be canceled. Selection automatically places an order subject to processing; existing cart cannot combine. General caps may aggregate person, household, order, account, payment and address. Drawing orders below $35 may incur delivery fees; existing-cart items cannot be added to meet the threshold.
confirmed.planningImpact: Confirm details before entry; profile counts do not expand the permitted household allowance. Rules match prior coverage.
